columns.dc:description: Name of the organisation issuing the tender opportunity.
A Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) which identifies the organisation.
Date of the end of the financial quarter to which the data relates, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Date suppliers can begin registering interest in the opportunity, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Unique reference number assigned to the tender.
Summary of the goods, services, or works being procured (CPV).
Planned commencement date of the contract, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Planned expiry date of the contract, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
Date the contract is due for review, in the ISO international date format YYYY-MM-DD.
